name: hud_ui_net_game_setup_overlay_owner_destructor
description: HudUiNetGameSetupOverlayOwner::~HudUiNetGameSetupOverlayOwner disables and deletes the owned setup panel, clears m_panel, and restores the base state vtable. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja still shows MSVC EH registration scaffolding, but the behavior-relevant panel cleanup and base-vtable transition are verified.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41abe0 validates installing the overlay-owner vtable, disabling m_panel via slot 1, deleting m_panel via slot 2 with flag 1, clearing m_panel, and restoring kRecoilStateBase_VtblAddress.
The native lifecycle smoke verifies test-owned object destruction invokes panel SetEnabled(0) and ScalarDeletingDestructor(1) without explicitly destroying the process-lifetime global.
